address: Kılıçali Paşa, Meclis-i Mebusan Caddesi No:8, Beyoğlu, Istanbul, 34433, Türkiye

tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: To soak up Galataport's trendy atmosphere, a spot on the front terrace overlooking the passing boats is the place to be. But whether you sip your cocktail alfresco or inside the modern bistro, you're in for an exceptional evening. The restaurant specialises in Spanish tapas reimagined through a Turkish culinary lens. You might start with prawns accompanied by a spicy cherry cream, move on to a shared plate of patatas bravas and grilled squid, and choose a more traditional main dish such as a pide or baked sea bass. The chefs have a flair for reinvention and have curated an enticing menu. Eating at Muutto makes for a great night out!
